name: agrointelx-devtools
description: Convenience scripts only. This is NOT an npm workspaces root — frontend/ and backend/ are fully independent projects, each with their own package.json, package-lock.json, and node_modules, so they can be deployed separately (frontend -> Vercel, backend -> Render).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.clean: npm run clean --prefix backend && npm run clean --prefix frontend
